say:3:1120812001:1.text: Alright, my furry friends... and my non-furry friend... Are we working together or what?
say:3:1120812001:1.source_cn: 老爷小姐们，怎么样，要不要一起合作？

say:4:1120812002:1.text: If the reward is really the Dusk Eye, that rock is worth a heck of a price.
say:4:1120812002:1.source_cn: 赏金真给残阳之眼的话，那可金贵得很，能值一大笔钱。

say:5:1120812003:1.text: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
say:5:1120812003:1.source_cn: ……真是见钱眼开的人，立刻见风使舵来找主人帮忙了！
say:5:1120812003:1.male: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
say:5:1120812003:1.female: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.

choice_prompt:6:1120812003.text: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
choice_prompt:6:1120812003.source_cn: ……真是见钱眼开的人，立刻见风使舵来找主人帮忙了！
choice_prompt:6:1120812003.male: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
choice_prompt:6:1120812003.female: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.

say:7:1120812004:1.text: Here's the deal. I know a thing or two about the Dusk Eye. That gem is worth a ton of gold.
say:7:1120812004:1.source_cn: 别这么说。残阳之眼嘛，我多少知道一些，那种宝石很能卖得...

say:8:1120812005:1.text: Now, the only problem is that spider venom. Those spiders are extremely dangerous, and the Crimson Highlands are as well. Not a soul would go there if not for news of treasure.
say:8:1120812005:1.source_cn: 悬赏要的蜘蛛毒液才是个大麻烦，诡蛛毒性太大。而且深红高...

say:9:1120812006:1.text: But on the contrary, my perky ears have heard rumors that some adventurers have actually come back alive!
say:9:1120812006:1.source_cn: 不过，我这双耳朵听说，有些英勇无畏的老爷小姐们不但进了...

say:10:1120812007:1.text: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
say:10:1120812007:1.source_cn: 怎么样，要不要一起？和我合作那可是……嗯……总之，绝不...
say:10:1120812007:1.male: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
say:10:1120812007:1.female: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!

choice_prompt:11:1120812007.text: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
choice_prompt:11:1120812007.source_cn: 怎么样，要不要一起？和我合作那可是……嗯……总之，绝不会亏待<male>老爷</male><female>小姐</female>您！
choice_prompt:11:1120812007.male: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
choice_prompt:11:1120812007.female: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!

say:12:1120812008:1.text: I knew the magister here was a smart one! I'm about to shed a tear!
say:12:1120812008:1.male: I knew the magister here was a smart one! I'm about to shed a tear!
say:12:1120812008:1.female: I knew the magister here was a smart one! I'm about to shed a tear!

say:13:1120812009:1.source_cn: 主、主人，就这么答应他了吗……

say:14:1120812010:1.text: I know you have your doubts, my furry friend. To show my sincerity in this endeavor, I'll handle the retrieval of the venom.
say:14:1120812010:1.source_cn: 我理解、我理解。仓鼠老弟，为了打消你们的疑虑，拿出合作...

choice_prompt:15:1120812010.text: I know you have your doubts, my furry friend. To show my sincerity in this endeavor, I'll handle the retrieval of the venom.
choice_prompt:15:1120812010.source_cn: 我理解、我理解。仓鼠老弟，为了打消你们的疑虑，拿出合作的诚意，这次悬赏要找的东西就包在我身上吧。

say:16:1120812011:1.text: Look, Magister, we all know you're a man of great ability. What if something else happens?
say:16:1120812011:1.male: Look, Magister, we all know you're a man of great ability. What if something else happens?
say:16:1120812011:1.female: Look, Magister, we all know you're a woman of great ability. What if something else happens?

say:17:1120812012:1.text: Come a little closer, I've got an idea.
say:17:1120812012:1.source_cn: 你们过来，离那位执事老爷远点！我有个主意。

choice:15:0:1.text: Didn't you say it was dangerous?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 你刚刚还说找蜘蛛毒液麻烦？
choice:15:0:1.male: Didn't you say it was dangerous?
choice:15:0:1.female: Didn't you say it was dangerous?

choice:15:1:2.text: Then what do you need me for?
choice:15:1:2.male: Then what do you need me for?
choice:15:1:2.female: Then what do you need me for?

say:19:1120812013:1.text: You still don't trust me, Magister?
say:19:1120812013:1.male: You still don't trust me, Magister?
say:19:1120812013:1.female: You still don't trust me, Magister?

say:20:1120812014:1.text: Don't forget what you did before, when you took Satrana's necklace. And instead of giving it back, you shot an arrow at Chippy!
say:20:1120812014:1.source_cn: 别忘了你之前做过什么，拿了萨忒娜的项链不还，还给了满满一箭！

say:21:1120812015:1.text: Theft, assault, and running away! You've done it all!
say:21:1120812015:1.source_cn: 盗窃、伤人、逃逸，可以说什么坏事都做啦！

say:22:1120812016:1.text: Hey, that's only because I've fallen on hard times!
say:22:1120812016:1.source_cn: 哎呀，那是因为我很穷啊，老爷小姐们。

say:23:1120812017:1.text: Here in Alkali, if you try to set up a merchant stall, you've got folks coming and skimming off your earnings! Stall fees, security fees, water fees... Look at this place! They have water fees here!
say:23:1120812017:1.source_cn: 咸水镇这地方，摆个摊子要被好几拨人来来回回收好几次钱，...

say:24:1120812018:1.text: That's not an excuse to do bad things!
say:24:1120812018:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，那不是你做坏事的理由！

say:25:1120812019:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to get moving if we want a chance at this bounty. It'll take quite a while to get to the Crimson Highlands and back.
say:25:1120812019:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to get moving if we want a chance at this bounty. It'll take quite a while to get to the Crimson Highlands and back.
say:25:1120812019:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to get moving if we want a chance at this bounty. It'll take quite a while to get to the Crimson Highlands and back.

say:27:1120812021:1.text: Sheesh, what a shame... I'll have to figure it out myself then.
say:27:1120812021:1.source_cn: 唉……可惜呀。那就只能我自己想办法了。

choice:11:1:2.text: I don't know if we can work together.
choice:11:1:2.male: I don't know if we can work together.
choice:11:1:2.female: I don't know if we can work together.

choice:6:0:1.text: Know anything about the Dusk Eye?
choice:6:0:1.male: Know anything about the Dusk Eye?
choice:6:0:1.female: Know anything about the Dusk Eye?

choice:6:1:2.text: Why should we work with you?
choice:6:1:2.male: Why should we work with you?
choice:6:1:2.female: Why should we work with you?

choice:6:2:3.text: Don't try and lie to me...
choice:6:2:3.source_cn: 你在我这里没有信誉度
choice:6:2:3.male: Don't try and lie to me...
choice:6:2:3.female: Don't try and lie to me...
